title: Randomly Permuted Orthogonal Products and Fast Dimension Reduction
summary: We study the effect of random signed permutations on products of orthogonal matrices and their applications to fast dimension reduction. Let $A,B \in \mathbb{R}^{d\times d}$ be orthogonal matrices and let $Σ\in \mathbb{R}^{d\times d}$ be a uniformly random signed permutation matrix. We analyze the random orthogonal matrix \[ U=A ΣB, \] and show that, under mild assumptions on the size of the entries of $A$ and $B$, \[ \max_{i,j=1,\ldots,d} |U_{ij}| =O\left ( \sqrt{\frac{\log d}{d}}\right ) \] with high probability.
